installCommand: cd "$VERCEL_GIT_REPO_ROOT" && corepack disable 2>/dev/null || true && npm install -g @pnpm/exe@10.33.0 && ( export PATH="$(npm prefix -g)/bin:$PATH" && hash -r 2>/dev/null || true && PNPM="$(command -v pnpm)" && echo Using pnpm at "$PNPM" && "$PNPM" -v && "$PNPM" install --no-frozen-lockfile )
buildCommand: ( export PATH="$(npm prefix -g)/bin:$PATH" && hash -r 2>/dev/null || true && PNPM="$(command -v pnpm)" && echo Using pnpm at "$PNPM" && "$PNPM" -v && "$PNPM" run build )
